examples.vi: Tổng chi phí sửa chữa ước chừng vào khoảng năm trăm đô la.

thesaurus.definition: a surrounding or nearby region

vi_block: Sự lân cận, sự tiếp cận.

examples: There was a crackling sound in the vicinity of my right ear.
wiktionary.gloss: Proximity; the state of being near.

examples: There is a hurricane in the vicinity of the Bahamas.
Al Jazeera's Scott Heidler, reporting from Bangkok, said hundreds of Yingluck's supporters gathered outside the Bangkok Supreme Court to await the verdict but were not allowed in the vicinity.
wiktionary.gloss: Neighbourhood; nearby region; surrounding area.

examples: I weigh in the vicinity of 80kg.
wiktionary.gloss: Approximate size or amount.

tatoeba.en: There are no hospitals in the vicinity of his house.
tatoeba.vi: Vùng lân cận xung quanh nhà anh ấy chẳng có cái bệnh viện nào.
